title: Heritage Mint Shannon D-84 14" Porcelain Doll Sweet and Innocent 1992 w/ Box Tag
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
conditionDescription: Taken out of box. Light stain on bloomers and small stain on tights - see close-up photo. Includes box, wrist tag and collector's guide.
descriptionText:
Heritage Mint "Shannon" D-84 - 14" Handcrafted Porcelain Doll
Sweet and Innocent Collection - The Heritage Mint Ltd. Collector Series - © 1992

You will receive the exact doll pictured. These are photos of the actual doll, not stock images.

Details:

Name: Shannon, model D-84

14 inch doll, hand-crafted in fine bisque porcelain, hand-painted face with blue eyes

Outfit: burgundy knit sweater with goose design, plaid skirt and matching plaid hat, white lace collar, bloomers, white tights and burgundy shoes

Heritage Mint Ltd., Scottsdale, AZ - © 1992 - Made in Taiwan (stamped on her shoe)

Includes the original window box, Heritage Mint wrist tag, and "The Collector's Guide to The Heritage Mint Ltd. Porcelain Doll Collection" booklet

Condition: Used / pre-owned - she has been taken out of her box. There is a light stain on her white bloomers (slip) and a small stain on her tights - please see the close-up photo. The box shows light shelf wear. Please review all photos closely; they are the best description of condition.

Box measures approximately 16 x 6 inches.
